review_candidates.description: Our client Taimur Shah Group Pvt Ltd is looking for a Building Management Systems Engineer in Islamabad Taimur Shah Group Pvt Ltd seeks an experienced BMS Proposal & Commissioning Engineer with strong expertise in Building Management Systems and HVAC controls. This role demands a candidate with at least three years of hands-on experience in system proposal development, engineering design, programming, testing, commissioning, and integration of various building automation and ELV/MEP systems. The ideal professional should demonstrate proficiency in preparing technical and commercial proposals, developing system and network architecture, selecting control components, and ensuring smooth project execution from tender to system handover. Familiarity with multiple BMS platforms and communication protocols is essential for executing complex integration tasks involving HVAC, lighting, security, and energy management systems. Responsibilities Review and analyze tender documents, specifications, drawings, and Bills of Quantities to understand project control requirements. Prepare detailed technical and commercial proposals, including BOMs, estimates, and quotations for BMS projects. Develop BMS system and network architecture, including I/O schedules, control schematics, and equipment selection. Select appropriate Direct Digital Controllers (DDC), I/O modules, sensors, actuators, control panels, gateways, and network devices. Review HVAC and MEP drawings to understand control strategies for Air Handling Units (AHUs), Fan Coil Units (FCUs), VRF systems, chillers, pumps, and ventilation equipment. Draft control philosophies, sequences of operation, technical submittals, compliance and method statements. Identify and document technical deviations, exclusions, risks, and specialized project requirements. Collaborate with sales during technical discussions, site surveys, client meetings, and tender clarifications to support project acquisition. Configure and program BMS/DDC controllers and supervisory systems to ensure accurate control and monitoring. Develop BMS graphical interfaces, alarms, trend logs, schedules, interlocks, control logic, and reporting features. Configure, verify, and troubleshoot communication protocols such as BACnet/IP, BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU/TCP for seamless device integration. Integrate multiple subsystems including HVAC, VRF, Energy Management Systems, Lighting Control, Water Management, CCTV, Access Control, Lifts, EV Charging, and Parking Management within the BMS framework. Set up communication gateways and validate data points, system status, command execution, alarms, and network communications. Perform detailed troubleshooting on controllers, field devices, communication networks, and software to resolve operational issues. Conduct thorough inspections of BMS hardware such as control panels, DDC controllers, I/O modules, sensors, actuators, field wiring, and network devices. Carry out point-to-point testing, I/O verification, loop checks, and functional testing aligned with project requirements. Test and commission HVAC control sequences including interlocks, alarms, schedules, and safety functions to certify performance. Verify communication integrity of BACnet and Modbus networks and verify third-party system integrations for compliance and functionality. Calibrate field sensors measuring temperature, pressure, humidity, flow, and other relevant parameters to ensure accuracy. Verify the operation and control of valves, dampers, actuators, Variable Frequency Drives, pumps, and fans within the system. Collaborate with HVAC, MEP, ELV, and project teams to conduct functional performance testing and troubleshoot system issues. Prepare comprehensive testing and commissioning reports, as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals, and final handover documentation. Conduct client demonstrations, provide system operator training, and manage smooth final system handover to the client.

Follow all company policies and undertake other reasonable responsibilities within the capability of the role.
